target.selector: Use the first published caesium-137 sample acquisition after the efficiency calibration in section 4, only if it has a separate certified or independently measured source strength, a published peak count and sufficient live-time and detector-geometry information.
target.ifIneligible: Record missing or shared evidence. Do not replace the target in this lock.

inputContract: Use parent decays during live acquisition, photon yield per parent decay, and conditional peak acceptance including matched geometry. The acceptance must come from a distinct acquisition and evidence family from the detector count being predicted.
background: Use the publication's pre-existing primary peak-area subtraction exactly as specified. If the necessary subtraction or net count is absent, mark the target ineligible. Do not choose a subtraction based on which candidate fits.

criterion.interpretation: An engineering discrimination tolerance declared for this retrospective check. It is not statistical coverage or a claim of laboratory precision.

limits: Frozen candidates come from software replays. This lock is local and hash-verifiable, and records order of work in this checkout. It is not a third-party timestamp or blinded preregistration.
